leftEvidence.title: The oath excludes the generation and places Moses beside it

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: The LORD hears the words, swears that the evil generation will not see the good land, and names Caleb and Joshua as exceptions.
points.right: At a later water crisis the people contend, Moses and Aaron fall before the LORD, and Moses strikes the rock after being told to speak to it.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Moses says the LORD was angry with him for the people’s sake and that he too would not enter; the children will possess the land.
points.right: Water comes out, but the LORD says Moses and Aaron did not believe or sanctify him and will not bring the assembly into the land.

payload.posture: Deuteronomy places Moses’ exclusion inside the Kadesh retelling; Numbers states the sentence at Meribah after striking the rock.

rightEvidence.title: Moses and Aaron are denied entry at Meribah

payload.tension: The texts provide different narrative placements and stated relations without explaining them to one another.
payload.title: Where Moses’ non-entry is located
